cohort: Pregnant women from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project Nationwide Inpatient Sample from 2004 to 2014
finding: Women with incarcerated uterus were more likely to experience adverse delivery and neonatal outcomes, including placenta previa, caesarean section, postpartum hemorrhage, and congenital anomalies.
mod_finding: Women with incarcerated uterus were more likely to deliver by cesarean section compared to the general population (aOR 2.4, 95% CI 1.8-3.1).
